pitch: Safely install, research, plan, connect, configure, and verify Quip Bot without exposing credentials to the agent.
problem: A useful chatbot needs grounded business knowledge, approved wording, consent, escalation rules, and a testable launch decision.
Chat-based setup often tempts people to paste WordPress passwords or provider keys into the AI conversation.
This skill separates human authorization from agent work and stores only non-secret, reviewable setup artifacts.

flow.d: Confirm authority, official installation, compatibility, and recovery.
Read public pages and cite the facts.
Collect only owner decisions the site cannot answer.
Temporary credential via the bundled helper; secrets stay out of the transcript.
Validate, approve, and apply one non-secret envelope through the setup API.
Expose passes, failures, and blockers before launch.

commands: Set up Quip Bot on my WordPress site
Research my site before configuring Quip Bot
Help me plan the Quip Bot knowledge base
Connect this WordPress site to the Quip Bot setup flow
Review whether Quip Bot is ready to go live

callout.label: Public alpha
callout.text: Version 0.3.0 ships both paths. **The API path is the default** — Quip Bot's stable setup API plus the bundled macOS credential helper — and the human-guided wp-admin path remains the fallback for multisite, older plugins, or unsupported credential backends.

limits.label: Safety boundaries
items: No WordPress passwords, Application Passwords, provider keys, or tokens in chat — the helper holds the temporary credential in the macOS Keychain.
No browser automation, SSH, XML-RPC, direct database writes, or internal admin routes; API calls stay inside quipbot/v1/setup.
No arbitrary plugin package, no production change without backup and explicit approval, and go-live is a separate approval that revokes the connection.
